module: "Mission" tab of the rally editor. It displays read-only the current mission's name, identifier and folder (with a button that opens the folder in the file explorer), then lists the mission-local voicepacks found in <missionDir>/rally/voicepacks/<name>/: folder, number of pacenote_*.ogg files and associated notebooks. The currently chosen voicepack is marked with a green star. The module returns a constructor (class C).
notes: Does not modify any data: purely informational tab.
If the info.json entry does not exist, the button opens the rally/ folder, otherwise the mission folder.
With no mission loaded, displays a message inviting you to open the editor from the Mission Editor.

C.desc: Tab object returned by the constructor (new(rallyEditor)). Fields: rallyEditor, path, windowDescription = 'Mission'.

setPath.desc: Stores the current notebook (called by the editor).

selected.desc: Called when the tab is selected: emits the hook onEditorEditModeChanged(nil, nil) to leave any edit mode.

unselect.desc: Called when the tab is left: emits the hook onEditorEditModeChanged(nil, nil).

draw.desc: Draws the tab's imgui interface (mission info, list of local voicepacks).
